events.title: Play the Demo of Momotaro and the Oni Island Right Now!
events.summary: The adventure begins today!We are super excited to announce that the playable demo for Momotaro and the Oni Island is officially live and available to download right now directly from our Steam Store page!What’s inside the Demo?Match-3 Combat: Experience our core battle mechanics where strategy meets puzzle-solving.First Map Gameplay: Choose your path, fight unique enemies, and try the companion abilities.We Want Your Feedback!As an indie developer, your feedback during this stage is invaluable.
